name: Boca Raton
intro: Boca Raton mixes older homes east of I-95 (where insurers often ask for 4-point and roof documentation) with newer gated communities to the west (where a wind mitigation report is usually the big premium lever).

name: West Palm Beach
intro: West Palm Beach has a lot of older housing, from 1920s bungalows in Flamingo Park and Grandview Heights to mid-century ranch homes, so many insurers ask for 4-point and roof documentation. Newer condos and townhomes often benefit most from a wind mitigation report.

name: Delray Beach
intro: Delray Beach mixes historic cottages and CBS block homes east of I-95, where 4-point and roof reports are common insurer asks, with newer gated communities to the west, where a wind mitigation report is usually the main premium lever.
